svg.title: The 47 Tucanae noise budget from HAYDNsim
svg.desc: Left: the median photometric noise per star against Gaia G magnitude in 47 Tucanae, split into photon, detector, target-jitter and crowding terms, with their total; crowding dominates for stars fainter than about 14th magnitude. Top right: the median stellar pollution ratio against magnitude, rising towards 0.37 at 18th magnitude. Bottom right: the share of stars whose light is mostly from neighbours, for seven clusters, from 40 per cent in 47 Tucanae to 3 per cent in M4.
svg.text: median per 0.3 mag bin in G, from 91,350 stars; four terms and their total
median share of each star's light that comes from its neighbours
